title: Integration & QA Engineer, HEART4Victims
subtitle: VCPMS, a multi-tenant case management platform state agencies use to process crime victim compensation claims. Sacramento, CA.
impact: I build and ship features on VCPMS, chase bugs down to the root cause, and work directly with state staff in production.
details: Built and shipped the Navigator Services Tracker for Alaska State Troopers' victim navigators end to end, from design calls to production (Angular 18, .NET 8, ABP, EF Core, Azure SQL).
Drove 130+ VCPMS bugs to resolution, including root cause fixes for claim saves silently deleting data and letter totals double counting voided payments.
Run production support and UAT with Oklahoma state staff three mornings a week. Brought 26 letter templates in line with the agency's originals.
Developed and maintained Playwright integration and end to end suites across multi-tenant Angular apps and .NET Core services: OAuth/JWT auth, document management, payments.
Used Azure DevOps Pipelines for CI/CD automated testing and release management.

title: Job Dashboard
subtitle: Gmail in, Claude classification, application history as events, and a macOS widget on top. Runs 24/7 on a home server.
impact: A pipeline that reads labeled Gmail, classifies each message with Claude into a validated schema, and stores application history as events, with an MCP server and a macOS widget on top.
details: Python pipeline reads labeled Gmail and sends each message to Claude with a structured output schema, so every result is validated before it's stored.
Application history lives in SQLite as events.
MCP server so I can add and move applications straight from Claude.
Native SwiftUI macOS widget shows the pipeline at a glance.
Runs 24/7 on a home server.

title: Farmland
subtitle: Online multiplayer adaptation of the board game Agricola, written in Go.
impact: An immutable rules engine and a bot that plays by simulating real moves, tuned over 150 simulated games.
details: Rules engine is immutable: every action takes a game state and returns a new one, which keeps it easy to test.
The bot plays by simulating real moves through the same engine. I tuned it over 150 simulated games.
Runs as a single Go process, and clients get updates over long polling.

Contributed to containerized deployments (Docker) and CI/CD workflows for UAV flight dashboards and APIs.
